mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal blood flow and inhibit prostaglandin-mediated sodium excretion, antagonizing the diuretic and natriuretic effects of loop diuretics while increasing risk of acute kidney injury and hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; consider alternative analgesia; ensure adequate hydration; adjust bumetanide dose if necessary and use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration.
